body.x: Daegu Technopark (Daegu TP, Director Eob Kwon) and the Mobile Technology Convergence Center (MTCC, Center Director Seok-Kwon Choi) announced it will jointly participate in the upcoming CES 2015, the world’s largest IT Electronics Exhibition, which will be held at the Las Vegas Convention Center (LVCC) from Jan. 6-9.

MTCC, together with some 23 Daegu-based mobile companies—Micro Display, JD SOUND, Samil CDS, RNware, Smart Medical Device, NTRex, ITWell, Soso H&C, Sky Digital, Clips Tech, KOMATECH, RoboBlockSystem, IRISYS, Huvitech, Windamp, M&G ENT, GreenPower Electronics, Clonix, Acetel, Nautilus Lab, KC Tech, Nolla Design, UzBRAINNet—plans to hold a joint exhibition space at the upcoming CES 2015 to introduce Korea’s IT mobile convergence products and technology to the world.

The main products for the participating companies include Micro Display’s Digital Signage Display, JD SOUND’s Monster GODJ, Samil CDS’s Transparent LCD Refrigerator, RNware’s HDMI Wireless Video Transmission, Smart Medical Device’s Dr.Music, NTRex’s RexBot3D OC-120 and MoonWalker, ITWell’s XPDA and UBITA device series, Soso H&C’s BRAINNO, Sky Digital’s Personal Data security solution, Clips Tech’s Neckband Bluetooth, and KOMATECH’s Freedy Dual Wireless Charger.

Other company products that will be displayed include RoboBlockSystem’s 3D Printer and ROBOBLOCK Kit, IRISYS’ LOCKIT USB, Huvitech’s automobile black box devices, Windamp’s bladeless fan, M&G ENT’s Twokey Pro Tablet PC, GreenPower Electronics’s wireless battery pack for iPhone, Clonix’s disk duplicator/wiper, Acetel’s Smart VJ Pole Series, Nautilus Lab’s pen tablet PC, KC Tech’s smart phone tempered glass protectors, “Nolla Design’s SOLARADE, UzBRAINNet’s Rail-Gun, and more at the upcoming exhibition.

Some 19 selected companies under the Product Development Project, a part of MTCC’s implementation project, will take part in CES 2015 together. Daegu TP provides a variety of marketing consulting support including technology issue resolution, intellectual property consulting, global market trend analysis, and strategic consulting for potential buyers.

The upcoming CES 2015 is designed to display the latest technology and products in consumer goods in one location and is commanding the attention of the global electronics industry. About 3,500 companies from 140 different countries are expected to participate with some 160,000 individuals predicted to attend the exhibition.
